system.description:
By painting the name of an enemy in ancient runes in blood on your body, you can bind spirits that will enact a curse upon your enemy when she sees it. Expend three Blood Traits and write the name of your enemy on the appropriate part of your body. The name must be painted in a visible location, but the enemy need not comprehend it. As soon as she sees it, she must win a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty seven Traits) or be affected. The curse lasts until the name is rubbed off or defaced (if you suffer four or more levels of damage).

Body (arms, legs, torso): the curse of weakness — mortals bid an extra Trait in all Physical Challenges, Cainites cannot use blood in any way other than the single Trait needed to stay active. Mind (forehead): the enemy must expend a Willpower Trait or automatically relent in any Mental Challenge. Voice (throat): the enemy loses the power of speech, though she may grunt. Soul (over the heart): the enemy is overwhelmed by primal feelings — mortals must flee your domain, Cainites are two Traits down on tests to resist frenzy.
